BiblicalUsage: The needy in the Bible are not a problem to manage but people God claims as His own concern. Moses says the poor will never cease out of the land, so Israel must open its hand wide, and Hannah's song says God raises the poor out of the dust and sets them among princes. Amos warns the merchants who swallow up the needy, and the psalmist tells judges to deliver the poor and needy out of the hand of the wicked.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe how a people treats its poor shows what it really believes about God, because He calls the needy His own. Caring for them is not charity on the side; it is part of obeying Him.
